programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 189
programme.desc: The segment features the Best of Motor Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025, highlighting top Italian and global innovations. This is contrasted with the high-capacity, versatile Hurricane 3200 Sundeck (MIBS 2025), and the luxurious downeast-style Back Cove 39O (MIBS 2025)

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 190
programme.desc: This segment offers a dramatic contrast, featuring the international excellence and new launches from the Best of Sailing Boats at Genoa Boat Show 2025 alongside two high-performance American powerboats at MIBS: the massive, quint-engine HCB 56 Sueños GIX, a center console yacht with 3,000 HP and luxury amenities, and the versatile Pursuit S328 Sport, which perfectly balances serious offshore fishing with premium family cruising and comfort.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 191
programme.desc: The segment features three diverse luxury vessels: the long-range comfort of the Absolute Navetta 62 trawler yacht; the high-speed performance of the Mystic M4200 (PBIBS 2025) center console with raceboat heritage; and the elegant Sirena 48 Coupe (PBIBS 2025), an owner-operated yacht known for its efficient hull and open design.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 192
programme.desc: This episode is dedicated to performance and versatility, highlighting the 50-knot Italian maxi-RIB Mar.co E44 with its luxury cabin. It also covers three premier US fishing boats: the wide-beamed Southport 38 FE (PBIBS 2025), the serious offshore Bertram 39 CC (PBIBS 2025), and the versatile hybrid bay boat Blackfin 262 HB (MIBS 2025).

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 193
programme.desc: This episode covers Italian design and high performance, featuring the stylish Ranieri Sauvage 34 luxury RIB and the premier charter offerings of Spartivento. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 195
programme.desc: This episode features the luxury and speed of the Celebration for the 40th anniversary of Pershing in Capri, alongside the superyacht prowess of Heesen Yachts' Agnetha, a 55-meter yacht with a 4,500 NM range. programme.title: 2018 Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach Finals Day | REPLAY
programme.desc: Today, Stephanie Gilmore and Italo Ferreira won the Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach, Stop No. 2 of the World Tour. After an exciting week of competitive drama, upsets and emotion, the final day of competition ran in 4-to-6ft conditions at the world renowned Bells Beach… 2018 marks the Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach’s 57th year around the sun, as well as 3x World Champion Mick Fanning's final event on the World Tour.

programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: VIVO Rio Pro presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: The World Title race is set to supercharge in Saquarema. programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Surf City El Salvador Pro 2025
programme.desc: Where the Pacific's perfect right-hand point break meets an unparalleled competition venue, the Surf City El Salvador Pro delivers an opportunity for CT athletes to earn critical points in the rankings ahead of the Mid-season Cut. Long, powerful walls offer endless opportunity for progressive maneuvers while the hollow sections demand split-second decision-making that can test even the most seasoned CT competitor. Replay all the action of Final's Day at Punta Roca.

programme.desc: The Championship Tour is Burleigh Bound. The Bonsoy Gold Coast Pro presented by GWM will go down at Burleigh Heads, a location with its own incredible legacy and rich in surfing heritage. This is the second to last stop of the Tour before the Mid-season Cut; every turn, every heat, every wave matters. Relive Final's Day action as the world's best fight to stay on tour and earn critical points in the World Title race.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | Julian Wilson's World Title Dream Comes Down To Pipe
programme.desc: Heading into the final event of the 2018 World Surf League World Tour, the Billabong Pro Pipe Masters, both Julian Wilson and Jordy Smith are facing career-changing performances. For Jordy, a big result at Pipeline could mean clinching the coveted Vans Triple Crown. For Julian, a Pipe victory will mean his first world title. In this final episode of All In: Life On The Championship Tour, you'll be alongside Wilson and Smith in the critical, tense final moments of the 2018 World Tour.

programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Casbah Coast | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 1
programme.desc: Host and Longboard Champion Sam Bleakley travels to Algeria with Australian longboarder and writer Lucy Small, French surfer and adventurer Erwan Simon, and local Dihya Nasri, the only female surfer in all of Algeria. They continue to explore the over 1,000 miles of mostly unsurfed Mediterranean coastline, paddling out at a slabbing wave near the capital city of Algiers. Sam Bleakley, Lucy Small, Erwan Simon, and Dihya Nasri have a dawn patrol session at a nearby break and meet some of the local surfers in the tight-knit community as they continue to explore Algeria, one of the Brilliant Corners of the earth.

programme.desc: It was an emotional day full of twists and turns, not the least of which was Matt Wilkinson's return to the Final at Snapper for the second straight year. programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Falls: Testament Of Love
programme.desc: The Falls: Testament of Love is a continuation of the story of RJ Smith and Chris Merrill, two Mormon missionaries that fell in love during their mission in a small town in Oregon. The boys haven't spoken in five years, but when an unexpected tragedy compells them back to the Oregon town where they served, they find themselves, once again, thrust into one another's lives. programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Falls: Testament Of Love
programme.desc: The Falls: Testament of Love is a continuation of the story of RJ Smith and Chris Merrill, two Mormon missionaries that fell in love during their mission in a small town in Oregon. programme.desc: Dan Notartomaso seeks $650,000 in funding for his companies, Peak Custom Construction and Oak and Iron Design Co. programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.sub-title: Fund Tank - Teach Your Heart Out
programme.desc: Mother-daughter duo Tosha Wright and Lisa Dunnigan from Teach Your Heart Out seek $600,000 in funding to propel their educational conference business to new heights. With a mission to rejuvenate and empower educators nationwide, they share their inspiring journey and ambitious plans with the panel of experts. Despite facing challenges such as the impact of COVID-19 on educational conferences and the need for strategic expansion, Tosha and Lisa impress with their passion and dedication to their cause.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Dr. Don Wood, CEO and founder of the Inspired Performance Institute, seeks funding to scale his groundbreaking trauma resolution program. Rooted in his personal journey to save his daughter from chronic illness, Dr. Wood's method resets the mind's response to trauma, yielding rapid and lasting results in just four hours. Despite financial challenges, Dr. Wood's vision to reach millions drives his pursuit of strategic partnerships and media exposure, highlighting the transformative potential of his innovative approach to healing.

programme.title: Fund Tank

Despite facing challenges, including the impact of COVID-19 on revenue, Eldridge's vision for scalability shines through, anchored by his signature dish, tamales.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: Escandalos - No Soy Una Mujer
programme.desc: Una diva de la música, estrella en los 80s, se ha convertido ahora en ídolo de la comunidad LGTB y en una de sus más fervientes defensoras. Pero cuando su hija le habla sobre su sexualidad y le comunica que quiere convertirse en hombre, sus convicciones se tambalean. Para ambas será una dura prueba de tolerancia y aceptación. Para el resto del mundo será un escándalo.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Jennifer como amante del dueno del canal, sigue planificanco su venganza contra Lara para que no vuelva al canal.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: Escandalos - No Soy Una Mujer
programme.desc: Una diva de la música, estrella en los 80s, se ha convertido ahora en ídolo de la comunidad LGTB y en una de sus más fervientes defensoras. Pero cuando su hija le habla sobre su sexualidad y le comunica que quiere convertirse en hombre, sus convicciones se tambalean. Para ambas será una dura prueba de tolerancia y aceptación. Para el resto del mundo será un escándalo.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
programme.desc: Directed by David Dhawan, this action-comedy features Govinda and Sanjay Dutt as conmen Tara and Sitara. Their escapades lead them to a military household, where they masquerade as patriots, resulting in a series of comedic events. The film combines slapstick humor with action-packed sequences.

programme.title: Khamoshiyan
programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Kalyug
programme.desc: Directed by Mohit Suri, Kalyug stars Kunal Khemu in his debut adult role. The film follows his character's descent into the pornographic underworld after a personal tragedy. As he seeks revenge, he uncovers the industry's seedy operations, leading to a gripping narrative about morality and redemption.

programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
programme.desc: Directed by Sangeeth Sivan, this ensemble comedy follows a colorful cast including a cross-dressing conman, a gangster, and a fake priest all scheming to get rich quick. programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.
